newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber flat in thin late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber flat in thin late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in thin late trading on Monday, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices remained at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.00-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"There are no fresh enquiries heard as many players are already on holiday," one Medan dealer said.
They said the market was generally quiet with few bids heard from Singapore for March SIR20 fob Surabaya at 54.00, but no deals were heard.
They said Singaporean firms on Friday bought February SIR20 at 55.15 fob Palembang and at 55.00 fob Surabaya for March shipments.
